name: @cluesurf/beat
description: TypeScript MIDI engine that drives Logic Pro / Superior Drummer 3 via the macOS IAC virtual MIDI bus.

scripts.play: tsx code/console/index.ts stop && tsx code/console/index.ts play
scripts.text:make: cd text && pnpm exec vsce package
scripts.text:load: cd text && pnpm exec vsce package && (code --uninstall-extension cluesurf.beat-text || true) && code --install-extension $(ls -t beat-text-*.vsix | head -1)
scripts.text:host: cd text && pnpm exec vsce publish
scripts.text:login: cd text && pnpm exec vsce login cluesurf
scripts.make: rm -rf host && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --pretty && rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && pnpm exec tsc-alias --project tsconfig.json --resolve-full-paths && chmod +x host/code/console/beat.js
